items.actClause: AN ACT to authorize Bnos Bais Yaakov to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for certain assessment rolls
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5889

TITLE OF BILL:

An act to authorize Bnos Bais Yaakov to file an application for
exemption from real property taxes for certain assessment rolls

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this bill is to permit the City of New York to accept
late application from Bnos Bais Yaakov for certain real property tax
exemptions for the 2013/14 and 2014/15 assessment rolls and if found
eligible, to grant exemptions and cancel all taxes, fines, penalties,
and interest and make appropriate correction of the subject assessment
rolls.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section one authorizes the NYC Department of Finance to accept. an
application for exemption of real property taxes pursuant to Section
420-a of the real property tax law for the 2013/14 and 2014/15
assessment rolls from the not-for-profit corporation Bnos Bais Yaakov.
This section further requests that the Department of Finance review
the application as if it had been received on or before the taxable
date established for these assessment rolls. If satisfied that Boos
Bais Yaakov would otherwise be entitled to such exemption, the
Commissioner of the Department of Finance, upon approval by the City
Council of New York City, may grant exemption from all taxation with
respect to the subject tax rolls and cancel taxes, fines, penalties,
and interest remaining unpaid, and make appropriate correction of the
subject assessment rolls

Section 2 is the enacting clause.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes Bnos Bais Yaakov to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for certain assessment rolls.
